mission_check.capability: Retain earned battle endpoints and test the frozen battler with a legitimately acquired reserve in natural trainer battles.
mission_check.learned_authority: Frozen J owns attacks, voluntary switches and replacements; preparation remains disclosed teacher gameplay.
mission_check.transfer_test: At most two unused natural boot origins, disjoint from the four TRAIN origins; frozen H and J at three paired timings.
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: One bounded source preparation failure stops preparation; any actor assistance or invalid execution prevents natural qualification.
mission_check.time_box: Two hours including implementation, preparation and comparison; reassess source preparation after 45 minutes.
mission_check.stop_condition: No route repair, source replacement, fitting, consumed-trial replay, full-game run or GitHub push. Missing meaningful switching coverage is reported, not manufactured.

chapters: Cerulean until required Rocket before actor selection
preparation.boundary: Mt. Moon required Rocket MAIN, two usable own Pokemon acquired by ordinary gameplay
preparation.disclosure: Existing teacher preparation includes its normal item sales, purchases, Zubat capture and move teaching. These are not model funding decisions or learned outcomes.
preparation.limitation: Two own members test reserve use, not a nontrivial choice among multiple forced-replacement targets or six-member competence.

comparison.order: boot ascending, timing ascending, H then J; all plans frozen before first cell
comparison.criteria: Terminal unassisted execution, no invalid actions or writes, no aggregate win regression versus H and actual reserve-use evidence. Perfect wins and statistical significance are not required.
comparison.retention: Retain final state bytes on success and failure before closing the emulator; bind successful runner results to source, model, log and snapshot.

integration.condition: Only if the declared natural test meets its gate
integration.selection: First successful J endpoint in declared order, without replay
integration.scope: One bounded earned-state semantic objective with fresh completion ledger; no full-player promotion.
